</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: 2em;"><b>Chen Ping’s Fifth
Strategy</b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<br />

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: x-large;"><i>Advising Liu Bang to Lure the Disobedient Han Xin into a Trap</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">After
Xiang Yu's death in 202 B.C., Zhongli Mo </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">(<span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">钟离昩</span></span>,
</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">d. 201 B.C.<span style="text-decoration: none;">)</span><span style="text-decoration: none;">,
one of Xiang Yu's generals, came to Han Xin seeking refuge, which Han
Xin granted him on account of their past friendship. When Liu Bang
heard of this, he ordered Han Xin to arrest him, but Han refused
</span><span style="text-decoration: none;">[18]</span><span style="text-decoration: none;">.</span></span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">
When a year had passed, and Liu Bang heard further that Han Xin was
plotting against him, and still harboring the fugitive Zhongli Mo,
Chen Ping suggested to him to lure Han into a <u>trap</u>. Han fell
for the ruse and was taken captive when he came to meet Liu Bang to
discuss the Emperor’s upcoming tour of the Marshes of Yunmeng -- a
fiction fabricated for Han Xin’s benefit. Although Liu Bang later
pardoned Han Xin, he still demoted him from vassal king to marquis.</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Advising
Liu Bang to Lure the Disobedient Han Xin into a Trap</span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span style="font-style: normal;">
is an application of the fifteenth stratagem, </span><i>Lure
the Tiger Out of the Mountains,</i>
which is associated both with the 39th and 40th hexagrams, <i>Water
over Mountain</i>, and
<i>Thunder over Water</i>,
respectively [1], [28].</span></p>

<div dir="ltr" id="Section52" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">formality/process:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">手续</span></span></span>:
	s</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">hǒuxù   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><a name="tw-source-rmn56"></a>
	service charge: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">手续费</span></span>:
	shǒuxù fèi   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">fee/cost:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">费用</span></span>:
	fèiyòng</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	to adapt: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">适应</span></span>:
	shìyìng   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	to give up: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">放弃</span></span>:
	fàngqì   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	to interrupt: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">打断</span></span>:
	dǎ duàn</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	rotten/spoiled: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">馊</span></span>:
	sōu</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	pirate: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">海盗</span></span>:
	hǎidào   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	privacy: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">隐私</span></span>:
	yǐnsī   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	private: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">私人的</span></span>/<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">私有的</span></span>:
	sīrén de/sīyǒu de</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	mainland (e.g. mainland China): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">大陆</span></span>:
	dàlù</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	quantity: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">数量</span></span>:
	shùliàng    
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><a name="tw-source-rmn77"></a></span>
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">to
	distract: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">分心</span></span></span>:
	fēnxīn  </span></span>
	</p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><a name="tw-target-text25"></a><a name="tw-target-rmn6"></a></span>
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">island: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">岛</span></span></span>:
	dǎo</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	Hong Kong: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">香港</span></span>:
	xiānggǎng</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	pretty woman: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">美女</span></span>:
	měinǚ  
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	handsome guy: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">帅哥</span></span>:
	shuàigē</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><a name="tw-source-rmn79"></a>
	to care (about): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">关心</span></span>/<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在乎</span></span>:
	guānxīn/zàihu</span></p>
</div><br>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
step (e.g. there are steps going up to the house): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">台阶</span></span>:
táijiē</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
to believe (e.g. to believe in someone): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">相信</span></span>:
xiāngxìn</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><a name="tw-source-rmn165"></a><a name="tw-source-rmn166"></a><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-size: large">trap (e.g., to set a trap): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-size: large" lang="zh-CN">陷阱/圈套:
xiànjǐng/quāntào</span></span></p>

<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><b>Sample Sentences 41:</b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><br />

</p><br>
<div dir="ltr" id="Section93" style="column-count: 2;"><div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她告诉我这个手续没有什么手续费，但是</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;我不相信她。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	2) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">牛奶馊了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
    3) </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-size: large">我真不敢相信，他给我下了圈套。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	4) </span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这个岛好多年前就被海盗控制了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	5) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在我房子的后面有木台阶，可以走到河</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;边。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	6) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他放弃了，因为他不能适应这里的天气。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	7) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">因为那个帅哥，她分心了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: Because of that
	handsome guy, she was distracted.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	8) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">请不要打断我说话。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: Please don’t
	interrupt me.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	9)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我们关心数量，也关心质量。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	10) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我国家的人很在乎隐私。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	11) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这个地方是私人的。</span></span></span></p>
</div>
